news.headline: Delcath Systems (NASDAQ:DCTH) Trading 9.3% Higher – Still a Buy?
news.summary: DCTH shares jumped 9.3% to a new 52-week high (~$16.51) on heavy volume in the wake of the Q2 earnings beat and H.C. Wainwright's price-target raise to $32 from $30. The move reflected continued investor enthusiasm for HEPZATO's accelerating commercial ramp.

news.headline: Delcath Systems Reports Second Quarter 2026 Results and Business Highlights
news.summary: Delcath posted Q2 2026 revenue of $29.1 million (up 20% YoY, beating consensus of ~$26.6M), with HEPZATO KIT sales of $27.1 million, gross margin expanding to 90%, and net income of $2.7 million; the company raised full-year 2026 revenue guidance to $104-108 million. HEPZATO volume grew about 30% YoY despite lower per-kit pricing from 340B program effects, and the company activated 2 new treatment centers, bringing the active total to 31.

news.headline: Delcath Systems to Participate at the Canaccord Genuity 46th Annual Growth Conference
news.summary: Delcath announced its management would present and hold investor meetings at the Canaccord Genuity 46th Annual Growth Conference in Boston on August 11, 2026.

news.headline: Delcath Systems, Inc. Announces Inducement Grants Under Nasdaq Listing Rule 5635(c)(4)
news.summary: Delcath disclosed restricted stock unit inducement grants totaling 17,000 shares made to new employees on July 1, 2026, as required disclosure under Nasdaq's inducement-grant listing rule, signaling continued hiring as the company scales its commercial organization.

news.headline: Delcath Systems Announces First Patient Dosed in Phase 2 Clinical Trial of HEPZATO in Liver-Dominant Metastatic Breast Cancer
news.summary: Delcath dosed the first patient, at the European Institute of Oncology in Milan, in its global Phase 2 DELUMA trial (NCT06875128) testing HEPZATO plus standard of care versus standard of care alone in roughly 90 patients with liver-dominant HER2-negative metastatic breast cancer, across 20+ US and European sites. This marks the company's second major pipeline expansion beyond its approved uveal melanoma indication, alongside its ongoing colorectal cancer program.

catalysts.label: 37 active HEPZATO treatment centers
catalysts.detail: Management guided to activating roughly six more US treatment centers by year-end 2026, bringing the active total from 31 to about 37, as a direct driver of continued revenue growth.

catalysts.label: 40 active treatment centers
catalysts.detail: Company has signaled a longer-term target of approximately 40 active HEPZATO sites by Q1 2027 as the US commercial network matures.

catalysts.label: DELUMA breast cancer trial site activation
catalysts.detail: Delcath is targeting activation of roughly 15 trial sites for its Phase 2 HEPZATO breast cancer study (DELUMA) by late 2026, following the July 2026 first-patient dosing.

catalysts.when: By year-end 2026 / interim data end of 2027
catalysts.label: Colorectal cancer (mCRC) trial progress
catalysts.detail: Delcath aims to activate nearly all 26 planned mCRC trial sites by year-end 2026, with interim data from the Phase 2 HEPZATO colorectal cancer study expected to be shared by the end of 2027.

catalysts.label: Q3 2026 earnings report
catalysts.detail: Delcath's next quarterly report is expected around mid-November 2026, consistent with its historical Q3 reporting cadence, though the exact date has not yet been officially announced.

pulse: Delcath is executing well commercially: Q2 2026 revenue rose 20% YoY to $29.1 million with 90% gross margin, prompting a raised FY26 guidance range of $104-108 million and sending shares to a 52-week high with analyst price-target upgrades (H.C. Wainwright to $32). Beyond the core HEPZATO uveal melanoma franchise, the company is broadening its pipeline with newly dosed Phase 2 trials in metastatic breast cancer (DELUMA) and ongoing colorectal cancer studies, while steadily expanding its US treatment-center network toward a 37-site year-end target. Overall sentiment is bullish, with near-term catalysts centered on site-activation pace, 340B pricing dynamics, and Q3 2026 earnings expected around November.
